meta.description: Barrens creature families and their own loot rows (1.12). An optional layer over loot_items.json level pools.
meta.source: vmangos world DB (github.com/vmangos/core release db_latest, sqlite) + 1.12.1 client DBCs

zone_rule: map 1, x in (-4700.0, 1400.0), y in (-3950.0, -1050.0), minus Dustwallow (x < -2600 and y < -2750); creature level_max <= 30; no bosses, critters or NPCs with gossip/vendor flags
families_note: drops are the family's own non-gear rows at >= 1%  (hides, fangs, meat, cloth, junk, food). Gear the DB lists per creature is counted in direct_gear_rows and left to the level pools. Rares (rank 2/4) and families with <= 2 spawns are merged into named_and_rare.
how_to_use: On a kill: roll each `drops` row at chance_pct_max (or the creature's own row via creature_loot_template), then roll the level pool for gear. `quest_drops` only drop while a quest wants them (negative chance in vmangos). `world_drop_refs` are the generic reference tables the family uses; loot_items.json level pools stand in for them.
